Fire at Liberation War Museum’s generator room doused
2025-03-10T13:53:54+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/accidents-fires/news/fire-liberation-war-museums-generator-room-doused-3844001

A fire broke out at the generator room of the Liberation War Museum in Dhaka's Agargaon area this morning.

The fire originated around 9:00am and two fire engines doused it around 9:55am, Fasir Uddin, senior station officer of Mohammadpur Fire Station told The Daily Star.

The cause of the fire is under investigation. No casualties have been reported yet, he said.

Asked about propaganda on social media that the fire was set deliberately, the fire official said they did not find any evidence to prove the claim.

"The room was locked and we rushed there immediately and unlocked it to douse the fire," he said.
